Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Progressive experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and variance reporting.
Prior accounting or financial analysis experience within a university or higher education environment.
Experience managing multi-unit budgets, fund accounting, and institutional payroll reconciliations.
Monitor budget-to-actual performance while analyzing and explaining financial variances and trends across three assigned DFA units.
Develop financial forecasts, planning tools, and comprehensive financial reports to support operational planning.
Reconcile ongoing financial and payroll activity to ensure accuracy and compliance across departmental accounts.
Partner with department leadership to provide actionable financial recommendations that guide resource allocation and strategic decision-making.
Strong analytical and reconciliation skills with advanced proficiency in spreadsheet modeling and financial reporting tools.
Working knowledge of Kuali Financial System (KFS) or similar enterprise financial platforms.
Ability to communicate complex financial data clearly and collaborate effectively with departmental leadership.
